content_sections.heading: VOCPA Visiting Consultant Super Specialist Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to send credentials for the VOCPA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for sending your credentials for the V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority recruitment is 01 September 2026. Ensure all necessary documents are submitted by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Visiting Consultant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Visiting Consultant Super Specialist (Medical Oncologist) position is Rs. 4000 per visit. This is a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q3. What are the required qualifications for this post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Visiting Consultant Super Specialist (Medical Oncologist) post, candidates must possess an M.D. and DM in Medical Oncology. These are the essential educational qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this position is 65 years. This applies to all candidates irrespective of their category.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this VOCPA job?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview on the specified date with all required documents. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority, Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu, 628004. Candidates should report to the venue on the interview date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable). Passport-size photographs are also recommended.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority recruitment is scheduled for 02 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.
